metadata.title: Media Franchise Atlas - editorial seed
metadata.description: Structured export of the franchise lists, film titles, narrative proposals and series candidates discussed in this conversation. Not a licensed API dump or independently audited film database.
metadata.scope: Selected theatrical feature-film cycles plus selected series candidates; not an exhaustive world catalog or complete inventory of all connected series.
metadata.count_warning: Do not sum franchise counts globally. Shared works appear in multiple memberships. editorial_count_claim preserves previous statements and must not override derived unique counts.
metadata.date_warning: release_year is a Gregorian year claim, not an exact date. No calendar conversion is supplied for year-only data.
metadata.chronology_warning: Narrative sequences are editorial proposals. Some use character journey rather than ascending in-universe dates. No conversion between fictional and real calendars is asserted.
metadata.ownership_warning: Company associations are not ownership, production or distribution facts. Parent relationships are unverified claims with unknown validity periods.
missing_data: Narrative dates and fictional calendar equivalences
known_issues: Pokemon prior count was 24. Enumerating both Victini versions, the CG remake and Detective Pikachu yields 25 distinct films in this seed; verify the desired counting convention.
Ghostbusters prior count was four; this export includes the 2016 theatrical reboot, yielding five.
Batman and Superman scopes include solo live-action films only; animated films, team films and cameos are excluded.
Alien excludes AVP; Predator excludes AVP and originally platform-released films.
One Piece excludes the short Straw Hat Chase; Tora-san excludes the expanded reissue; Carry On excludes the compilation.
Zatoichi scope is the Shintaro Katsu cycle, not all subsequent adaptations.
2026 titles and all corporate changes must be rechecked against authoritative sources before publication.
Related-series membership does not imply common narrative continuity: animated X-Men and Batman differ from live-action films.
Dune: Prophecy and Justice League series candidates await appropriate franchise/umbrella records.

import_contract.ids: Stable in this seed only. Do not recompute IDs after title corrections; resolve external IDs and merge duplicates explicitly.
import_contract.null: Unknown or not supplied, never a fabricated value.
import_contract.unverified_import: Import into draft/review state; retain editorial changes on subsequent imports.
import_contract.release_sort: release_year only; within-year order is an editorial tie, not verified date order.
import_contract.narrative_sort: Filter to one narrative sequence and order its items by position. Never sort by release_year to obtain narrative chronology.
import_contract.count_query: Count distinct work_id for included memberships and the desired work format. Restrict eligibility using reviewed release evidence.
import_contract.empty_sections: Structures reserved for enrichment. No people, credits, exact dates or location facts have been invented.
